---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or change to shopRex
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the use case - what are you trying to do that shopRex
doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see added or changed.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.

**Additional context**
Note if this would require a new dependency - shopRex intentionally ships
with zero required Composer/npm packages (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)), so features needing one are usually documented as an opt-in rather than built in by default.
